name: Certifier
description: Certifier is a digital credentials platform that enables you to create, manage, and verify digital certificates and badges at scale.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Certifier to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Certifier to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.certifier.io/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Certifier MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Certifier lists 18 MCP tools, including attributes-list, credentials-create, credentials-createIssueSend, credentials-delete, credentials-designs, credentials-get, credentials-issue, credentials-list, credentials-search, credentials-send, credentials-update, and designs-get.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Certifier?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Certifier in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Certifier requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Certifier is developed by Certifier. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
